hooks.command: set +u; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}" .; do f="$r/hooks/session-start-context.md"; [ -r "$f" ] && { cat "$f"; exit 0; }; done; echo "postman-plugin: SessionStart hook could not locate hooks/session-start-context.md - no plugin-root variable resolved (tried CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT, KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT, PLUGIN_ROOT, cwd)" >&2; exit 1
